stem: The random variables $X$ and $Y$ have independent distributions $X \sim \text{Po}(3)$ and $Y \sim \text{Po}(2)$ respectively.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The total of 100 random values of $X$ and 150 random values of $Y$ is denoted by $T$.

Use a suitable approximating distribution to find $\text{P}(T < 560)$.
